changed: Switching a figure of your own to the app's figure of the same name can now turn a places parameter into a plain number parameter, which takes every count places can. Your starburst figure, whose count is in places, can now switch to the app's starburst: each dance keeps its count, which reads “around 2” instead of “around 2 places”.

`userFigureSwitchTargets` offers a `ParamKind.number` target for a `ParamKind.places` parameter, as well as one of its own kind; the value is kept as it is. A number parameter still never maps onto places.
